info.name: EPFL Actu News Categories Events API
List all Event objects with filtering.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: title
params.description: Filters the events containing the given text in the title.

params.name: description
params.description: Filters the events containing the given text in the description.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Filters the events which start at the given start_date.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Filters the events which finish at the given end_date.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Filters the events which start at the given start_time.

params.name: end_time
params.description: Filters the events which finish at the given end_time.

params.name: start_year
params.description: Filters the events which start at the given start_year.

params.name: place_and_room
params.description: Filters the events containing the given text in the place and room.

params.name: spoken_languages
params.description: Spoken Language ID. Return only the events with the given spoken language.

params.name: memento
params.description: Memento ID. Return only the events in the given memento.

params.name: category
params.description: Category ID. Return only the events linked to the given category.

params.name: theme
params.description: Theme name. Return only the events linked to the given theme.

params.name: keywords
params.description: Keywords name. Return only the events linked to the given keywords.

params.name: vulgarization
params.description: Vulgarization ID. Return only the events with the given vulgarization.

params.name: registration
params.description: Registration ID. Return only the events linked to the given registration.

params.name: domains
params.description: Domain ID. Return only the events linked to the given domain.

params.name: academic_calendar_category
params.description: Academic Calendar Category ID. Return only matching events.

params.name: speaker
params.description: Filters the events containing the given text in the speaker.

params.name: organizer
params.description: Filters the events containing the given text in the organizer.

params.name: contact
params.description: Filters the events containing the given text in the contact.

params.name: search
params.description: A search term.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.
